admitted_statement: For finite-field subspace arrangements with k distinct geometric subspace classes and arbitrary positive multiplicities, endpoint compression plus the ternary bottleneck DP computes exact path-width. If s classes are singleton and r are repeated, the endpoint-state DAG has exactly 2^s*3^r admissible states and exactly s*2^(s-1)*3^r + 2r*2^s*3^(r-1) directed transitions (with absent-type terms zero). Hence states <=3^k and transitions <=k*3^k. After 2^k subset-rank preprocessing, lambda(P,S)=rho(S)+rho(K\P)-rho(K) is an O(1) state-width query, so combinatorial DP work is O(k*3^k).

claim_ceiling.allowed: Exact path-width computation for finite-field subspace arrangements with k distinct geometric subspace classes and arbitrary positive multiplicities, using endpoint compression and the stated ternary DP within the admitted formal scope.
